title: Trump Wants Putin to End the War. He May Offer Russia Business Deals First.
summary: A new sanctions bill is meant to pressure President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia to end the war in Ukraine. But President Trump is doubling down on a different approach: offering enticements to Russia.
